label: Diagram 19
caption: Diagram 19 Heights and arrangement of fittings in a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet (looking towards wall A in diagram 18)
description:
An elevation of one wall of a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet ('looking towards wall A in diagram 18'), showing the heights and arrangement of fittings.

On the left are a 'Sanitary dispenser with coin slot between 750mm and 1000mm above the floor' (with an '800–1000mm' dimension beside it), a 'Shelf', and a 'Disposal bin' below. A '720–740mm' dimension rises to the level of the shelf and the basin rim. A possible hand dryer position ('HD') is above, and vertical 'Grab rails' are either side of the basin, with soap ('SD') and paper towel ('PT') dispensers above it.

On the right is the WC, its seat at '480mm*' ('*Height subject to manufacturing tolerance of WC pan'), with a toilet paper dispenser ('TP') and alarm reset button ('AR') above. Horizontal 'Grab rails' are at '680mm' and '1100mm', with a vertical rail marked '300mm' above and below the 1100mm line. A dashed shelf on the right is labelled 'Location of shelf at 950mm above floor level'. An 'Alarm pull cord with two red bangles one at 100mm, the other at 800mm to 1000mm above floor level' hangs by the WC.

Notes give the key to the letters and say: 'Height of drop-down rails to be the same as the other horizontal grab rails'.
model_description:
This drawing is a diagram showing the heights and arrangement of fittings in a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet, looking towards wall A.

The diagram shows a rectangular wall area with various fittings. On the left, a 'Shelf' is positioned with a dimension of '720-740mm' from the floor. Above this, a 'Sanitary dispenser with coin slot' is indicated to be 'between 750mm and 1000mm above the floor'.

The center of the wall features several items: a 'HD' (possible position for automatic hand dryer), 'SD' (soap dispenser), 'PT' (paper towel dispenser), 'TP' (toilet paper dispenser), and 'AR' (alarm reset button). These are arranged horizontally. A 'Grab rails' symbol is shown near the shelf and another below the dispensers. An 'Alarm pull cord with two red bangles' is indicated, with one bangle 'at 100mm' and the other 'at 800mm to 1000mm above floor level'.

Dimensions provided include '480mm' between the shelf and the soap dispenser, '300mm' height for the dispensers/shelf area, and '1100mm' and '680mm' vertical measurements on the right. A 'Disposal bin' is located at the bottom left.
